content:
The script successfully generated a multi-sheet Excel audit and a Word executive brief by prioritizing openpyxl for data integrity and dynamic aggregation.
The implementation used openpyxl to preserve None values from the 'RawData' sheet, avoiding pandas' NaN conversion issues. It correctly calculated 'Grand Total' rows for the Summary sheet while filtering for Total Errors > 0. The python-docx brief dynamically extracted high-priority Item Codes and totals from the generated Excel data. Validation confirmed the presence of all three required sheets and accurate final row formatting.
